attempted_claim: Let M16 be the closed orientable arithmetic hyperbolic 4-manifold constructed by Conder-MacLachlan as the orientable double cover of the non-orientable torsion-free quotient of the compact Coxeter simplex group [5,3,3,3] of Euler characteristic 8, so chi(M16)=16 and Vol(M16)=64*pi^2/3 by Chern-Gauss-Bonnet. Prove or disprove that the first Betti number b1(M16)=0. A complete answer must either certify vanishing via abelianization of the explicit torsion-free finite-index presentation (Reidemeister-Schreier certificate), or exhibit a nontrivial homomorphism from pi1(M16) to Z with an explicit infinite-order class in H1(M16;Z) and its abelian-invariants certificate, refuting vanishing.
decisive_failure: The b1(M16) decision could not be completed in this pass because the explicit Conder-MacLachlan torsion-free subgroup data (index-115200 kernel and index-230400 orientable cover of [5,3,3,3]) was unrecoverable: the AMS source PDF was Cloudflare-blocked with no working mirror, and this environment has no GAP/Magma/Sage CAS and no install path. Local lemmas (chi_orb=1/14400, W^ab=Z/2, b1=b2+-7) were verified but are routine checks that do not decide the Betti number, and no independently auditable adjacent alternative existed.
